Q. 1 عَرْجَنَهُ He struck him, or beat him, with an عُرْجُون [q. v.]. (S, K.) And عَرْجَنَهُ بِالعَصَا He struck him, or beat him, with the staff, or stick. (TA.) ―
-b2- And He figured it (i. e. a garment, or piece of cloth,) with the forms of عَرَاجِين, pl. of عُرْجُونٌ. (K.) ―
-b3- And He smeared, or rubbed over, him, or it, with blood, or with saffron, or with خِضَاب [i. e. hinnà, or the like]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
